record.question: What is the punishment for attempts to commit any offence under NDPS Act?
options: Punishment provided for the offence he attempts to commit or attempts to cause it to be committed
Imprisonment up to 6 months or with fine up to Rs. 10,000 or with both
Imprisonment up to one year or fine up to Rs. 20,000 or with both
Imprisonment up to two year or fine up to Rs. 20,000 or with both
